title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(泉井良夫研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Izui Yoshio)
keywords: Energy management 2.Renewable energy 3.EV utilization 4.Energy share 5.Electric heat cooperation
educationalGoal: Cource objective is establishing the theme for supplying low-carbon safe and reliable power and energy in the local community(GX). Through this objective, you will understand the social and technical background for power and energy technology as an electrical system expert and cultivate an engineering sense such as problem solving, communication ability and DX. In this project being conducted, the results are summarized as a paper.
advice: [Aim and tasks of the projec] This course is the final course in the design project process, including the introduction to design project, and is regarded as a course that integrates the items learned in all design projects. Aim to review basic course and acquire advanecd expertise through experiments and theoretical studies. Project activities will be conducted alone or in groups. You will meet weekly and report the progress in your weekly activity report based on your daily communication. The annual schedule is as follows. (1) The firat half classes: Based on the project proposal, create an assumed project schedule for the research contents of the first half classes. Learn the basics of research and submit weekly activities to accelerate and revise plans quickly. (2) The second half classes: With fhe final report in mind, conduct research activities continuously, prepare weekly reports, and activate discussios. The results are put together in a paper and presented at the public presentation review board. In addtion, you will submit the hand-over materials for students of the next fisical year. [Examples of project theme] (1) Collection and analysis of measurement data of Hakusan-roku campus energy management demonstration system, (2) Modeling and simulation of micro grid system, (3) Autonomous control system with thermo-electrical coordination or DC d-loop control for micro grid system, (4)V2X system for EV utilization for energy management system.
requiredKnowledge: The energy management system is an integareted field of study that deals with all of creation, transmission, storage use of electricity and energy, and from hardware devices such as power generatio, storage, demand, control and mobility. Futhremore, in relation to global environment issues and regional cooperation, Professro in charge hope that you acquire knowledge in a wide range of fields, from elemental technology to system wide technology and even business models.

activityGoals.body: You can define the purpose of research and make a reserach plan
You are able to communicate well with research group members and Professor in order to promote research
You can solve your own problems or issues in research
You can summarize the research results in the final report (project report)
You can explain research contents and present your researech resutls effectively
